data.title: 雷姆 · 女仆咖啡厅
data.description: 【雷姆 · 女仆咖啡厅】装潢温馨可爱的现代女仆咖啡厅里，雷姆双手端着冒着热气的特调拿铁咖啡，奶泡上已经用巧克力酱画好了一颗小爱心。她向你露出甜美的招牌笑容——「欢迎主人回家！这杯注入了雷姆满满爱意的魔法咖啡，请主人趁热享用哦！」
data.camera: medium shot, serving coffee tray with gentle smile
data.promptProse: Rem offers the tray in both hands, a chocolate heart on the latte foam; warm cafe light shines through steam beside her smile.
data.animaCaption: A chocolate heart rests on the latte foam above the offered tray.
